title: Technical training and new skills: human capital in construction 4.0
titleOriginal: TECHNICAL TRAINING AND NEW SKILLS: HUMAN CAPITAL IN CONSTRUCTION 4.0
excerpt: The main advantages of AI include greater operational efficiency, safer construction sites, environmental sustainability, and reduced human error.
lede: Vitruvius & Partners invests in professional development to drive innovation and sustainability in the construction sector.
html:
The construction industry is undergoing a significant transformation, driven by digitalization, sustainability, and the adoption of advanced technologies. To meet these challenges, it is essential to invest in human capital, equipping professionals with the skills needed to operate effectively in the environment of Construction 4.0.

Vitruvius & Partners, a company specializing in construction, renovations, and building services with operations nationwide, recognizes the importance of continuous training. The company promotes the adoption of digital tools such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) and artificial intelligence to optimize design and site management. These technologies require specific skills, which Vitruvius & Partners develops through internal training programs and collaborations with specialized institutions.

In Italy, initiatives like the 4.0 Skills School at the MADE Competence Center offer training paths to acquire expertise in Industry 4.0, including courses on augmented and mixed reality applied to construction sites. Events such as the Construction Innovation Days 2025, organized by TeamSystem, provide further opportunities for updates on digitalization, sustainability, and business management in the AEC sector.

Vitruvius & Partners actively participates in these initiatives, integrating the acquired skills into its business processes. The company also places great value on soft skills, such as leadership and team management, which are crucial for tackling the challenges of modern construction.

title: Artificial intelligence and construction: the future of building has already begun
titleOriginal: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND CONSTRUCTION: THE FUTURE OF BUILDING HAS ALREADY BEGUN
excerpt: The main advantages of AI include greater operational efficiency, safer construction sites, environmental sustainability, and reduced human error.
lede: From generative design to predictive maintenance, AI is transforming the construction industry. Vitruvius & Partners is leading the way with innovative and sustainable solutions.
html:
The construction sector — which accounts for about 13% of global GDP — has seen productivity grow by just 1% per year over the past few decades. That’s far behind other major industries.

Today, however, fueled by tax incentives, new environmental regulations, and increasing demand for smart buildings, construction is finally embracing digital innovation.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is driving this change. Technologies like Machine Learning and Deep Learning are being applied across many areas: from generative design that optimizes architectural projects, to Building Information Modeling (BIM) software for smarter project management, and virtual reality that allows clients to explore spaces before they’re built.

The benefits of AI in construction are clear:

  • Operational efficiency: faster project execution and lower costs for design, construction, and maintenance.
  • Safety and prevention: real-time monitoring and early detection of risks, leading to safer work environments.
  • Sustainability: optimized energy use and a smaller carbon footprint.
  • Reduced human error: precision-programmed robots help minimize the mistakes often seen in traditional construction.

Of course, challenges remain. Resistance to change and the initial investment required are still barriers for many companies. But forward-thinking firms like Vitruvius & Partners are proving that technological innovation is not just possible it’s essential.

The construction industry of the future will be more efficient, safer, and more sustainable. And with AI leading the charge, that future is already taking shape.

title: Zero-kilometer sustainable energy: the revolution of ground-mounted photovoltaics
titleOriginal: ZERO-KILOMETER SUSTAINABLE ENERGY: THE REVOLUTION OF GROUND-MOUNTED PHOTOVOLTAICS
excerpt: Sustainable solutions for the energy transition: ground-mounted photovoltaics enhances the land without consuming valuable resources. Ground-mounted PV is one of the most widespread…
lede: Sustainable solutions for the energy transition: ground-mounted photovoltaics enhances the land without consuming valuable resources.
html:
Ground-mounted PV is one of the most widespread and proven solutions for renewable energy production. By installing solar panels on flat surfaces, this technology maximizes solar irradiation, offering a clean alternative to fossil fuels.

One of the main advantages is the ability to install systems on vast, non-productive areas such as marginal land or decommissioned industrial sites, thus avoiding the use of high-value agricultural land. Additionally, the modular nature of these systems allows for customized installations, ranging from small plots to large solar parks capable of powering entire communities.

Ground-mounted PV plants are designed to maximize efficiency: the optimal orientation and tilt of the panels ensure consistent energy production throughout the year. Moreover, new technologies, such as bifacial panels, allow sunlight to be captured from both the front and the rear, further increasing performance.

In Italy, PV has made a significant contribution to the energy transition. Regions like Puglia and Sicily, characterized by high solar irradiation, host numerous plants that generate energy for thousands of families, reducing CO2 emissions and energy costs.

title: Renew and optimize: the future of rooftop photovoltaics and revamping
titleOriginal: RENEW AND OPTIMIZE: THE FUTURE OF ROOFTOP PHOTOVOLTAICS AND REVAMPING
excerpt: Renewing existing systems and utilizing unused spaces for a greener future. Rooftop photovoltaics is one of the most practical and widespread solutions for…
lede: Renewing existing systems and utilizing unused spaces for a greener future.
html:
Rooftop photovoltaics is one of the most practical and widespread solutions for renewable energy production, ideal for both private homes and commercial or industrial buildings. By using existing surfaces, such as roofs or coverings, these systems do not require additional land use, integrating seamlessly with the environment.

In recent years, the revamping of existing photovoltaic systems has become a critical issue to ensure efficiency and competitiveness. Many systems installed over a decade ago are now outdated compared to current technological standards. Revamping involves replacing modules, inverters, or support structures, improving the plant’s production capacity and extending its lifespan.

Thanks to technological advancements, new panels offer superior performance, making the most of the available solar irradiation. Moreover, the adoption of advanced monitoring systems helps optimize performance and detect any malfunctions promptly.

In Italy, rooftop PV is supported by policies promoting renewable energy, such as the Superbonus and incentives for revamping. These initiatives have allowed many families and businesses to reduce energy costs and environmental impact, contributing to the country’s ecological transition.

title: Floating photovoltaics: growth opportunities for Italy
titleOriginal: FLOATING PHOTOVOLTAICS: GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES FOR ITALY
excerpt: Clean energy and innovation: floating photovoltaics harness unused bodies of water for a more sustainable future. Floating photovoltaics represent an exciting opportunity, combining…
lede: Clean energy and innovation: floating photovoltaics harness unused bodies of water for a more sustainable future.
html:
Floating photovoltaics represent an exciting opportunity, combining innovation and sustainability. This technology, already adopted in countries such as Norway and France, makes use of closed bodies of water, such as lakes and artificial basins, to install solar panels capable of producing clean and renewable energy.

One of the main advantages is the reduction of water evaporation, a crucial aspect during periods of drought. Additionally, the panels, naturally cooled by the water beneath them, operate under optimal conditions, enhancing energy performance compared to land-based installations. Indeed, the efficiency of solar cells decreases as temperatures rise; however, the natural cooling effect of floating panels helps maintain high performance.

Italy has been one of the pioneers in this technology: as early as 2010, the first floating system was set up in Bubano, between Bologna and Imola. However, the development of these systems has slowed down in recent years, despite the great potential of our territory. Artificial basins, abandoned quarries, and natural bodies of water could host numerous plants, significantly contributing to renewable energy production.

For example, in Veneto, covering 20% of the surfaces of non-operating quarries would allow for the generation of 3,000 GWh per year, with a positive impact on both the environment and the local economy. Floating PV is a promising solution to accelerate your country’s energy transition, positioning it as a leader in innovative and sustainable solar energy production. For these reasons, Vitruvius & Partners has decided to make floating PV one of its principal business lines.

title: BESS: the silent force powering the future of renewable energy
titleOriginal: BESS: THE SILENT FORCE POWERING THE FUTURE OF RENEWABLE ENERGY
excerpt: Optimizing renewable energy and improving efficiency with batteries supporting the electrical grid. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are one of the most promising…
lede: Optimizing renewable energy and improving efficiency with batteries supporting the electrical grid.
html:
Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are one of the most promising innovations in the energy sector, poised to play a key role in the transition to more reliable and efficient renewable energy sources. These energy storage systems, which use advanced batteries to store electrical energy, allow for the optimization of renewable sources like solar and wind power, compensating for their intermittent nature.

The operation of a BESS plant is simple yet highly effective: excess energy produced during periods of high generation, when energy demand is low, is stored in the batteries. This stored energy can then be released during peak demand times, when renewable production is insufficient to meet consumption needs. This way, BESS plants not only improve the management of renewable resources but also contribute to the stability and resilience of electrical grids, reducing the need for fossil fuels to cover demand peaks.

These systems are particularly useful in areas with a high concentration of solar and wind plants, where energy production is subject to daily and seasonal fluctuations. BESS helps reduce the phenomenon of “curtailment” (the interruption of production to avoid grid overload) and makes renewable energy more predictable and available.

In Italy, BESS installations are gaining traction as part of a broader strategy to modernize electrical infrastructure and promote the growth of renewable energy. Their use allows for the maximum utilization of clean energy potential, ensuring a stable, cost-effective, and low-carbon energy supply.

The future of BESS looks very promising, with ongoing technological advancements improving their efficiency, lifespan, and cost. These energy storage systems are set to become increasingly central to decarbonization strategies and the development of smart, sustainable electrical grids.

title: Sustainable construction. Contract worth over 10 million euros for an energy-efficient residential area in the heart of Brianza
titleOriginal: SUSTAINABLE CONSTRUCTION. CONTRACT WORTH OVER 10 MILLION EUROS FOR AN ENERGY-EFFICIENT RESIDENTIAL AREA IN THE HEART OF BRIANZA
excerpt: Vitruvius & Partners, in partnership with Panzeri Architetti, has launched a building requalification project focused on sustainability to give a new look to…
lede: Vitruvius & Partners, in partnership with Panzeri Architetti, has launched a building requalification project focused on sustainability to give a new look to 58 apartments and reduce the entire residential estate’s electricity consumption by 50%.
html:
The construction site is located in Airuno, in the province of Lecco, just a few steps away from the Lake of Como, and less than an hour from Milan, in the typical suburban landscape of Brianza. The project – a contract worth over 10 million euros – involves the complete eco-sustainable renovation of CIVITAS 5, a residential compound of 3 buildings with 58 apartments.

The project: green renovation

A comprehensive green approach will be taken to rethink the buildings. The renovation of the interior spaces will involve the use of stone and wood, while the external facades will feature natural materials along with lush vegetation, inspired by Boeri’s Bosco Verticale (a well-known reforestation project in the center of Milan). To ensure energy efficiency, doors and windows providing thermal and acoustic insulation, photovoltaic panels, wind power systems with storage units, and electric vehicle charging stations will be installed. Designed and coordinated by Vitruvius & Partners in collaboration with architect Fabio Panzeri and his team of urban regeneration experts, the project will employ skilled workers and industry professionals.

Requalification means value

This combination of interventions will result in a drastic reduction in energy consumption: over the half of the current level (the residential estate has indeed been nicknamed “the bill-proof compound” already). At the same time, this will significantly reduce CO2 emissions and give a real contribution to improve the quality of the environment. Moreover, the constant focus on style – from project design to material supply selection – will provide buildings that are starting to show their signs of aging with a fresh look. Because in Vitruvius & Partners’ vision, requalification means value: in terms of environmental, economic and aesthetic benefit. For the sake of the planet and of its inhabitants.

To learn more, read the articles about the project published by Il Corriere Nazionale, Affariitaliani.it, Agi, Pledge Times, Il Globo

title: Superbonus 110%: the news for 2023
titleOriginal: SUPERBONUS 110%: the news for 2023
excerpt: After the assumptions, the final rules come to use Superbonus 110% during 2023: from 110% to 90% – here’s who can access it…
lede: After the assumptions, the final rules come to use Superbonus 110% during 2023: from 110% to 90% – here’s who can access it
html:
For 2023 Superbonus 110% is confirmed, with some significant changes: the tax deduction, indeed, will drop to 90%, but the variation will happen gradually. Superbonus 110% will remain valid for condominiums who have deliberated work execution no later than 18 November 2022, with consequent deposit of Cila-S no later than 31 December 2022; or with work execution deliberation of a date between 19 and 24 November 2022 and and deposit of Cilas-s made no later than 25 November 2022.

An extention for Superbonus has been scheduled – to 90% – also for single-family apartments, provided that the building subject to intervention is is the main residence of the taxpayer, who shall have property law and reference income less than 15.000 euros.

In addition, Superbonus 110% will remain so – in the presence of specific requirements – until 31 December 2025 for non-profit organizations and voluntary organizations who carry out health and welfare activities. Instead, non-profit organizations and associations who do not perform the above services can access Superbonus amounting to 90%.

By joining the Superbonus, i twill still be possible to opt for discount in invoice or sale of receivables, for which some innovations have been introduced. In particular, 5 steps will be possible – compared to 4 previously admitted -, of which, following the first free disposal, the additional may be made in favour of qualified entities, such as banks, financial intermediaries and insurance, while the last can be carried out by bank towards account holders VAT numbers.

title: Energy transition – not just a green change
titleOriginal: ENERGY TRANSITION – NOT JUST A GREEN CHANGE
excerpt: Energy transition is the essential tool to achieve the European objective of full decarbonisation by 2050 The energy transition consists in the transition…
lede: Energy transition is the essential tool to achieve the European objective of full decarbonisation by 2050
html:
The energy transition consists in the transition from a system based entirely on electricity produced from fossil fuels to a new and more sustainable low-carbon system, powered by renewable sources.

The great importance of this transition is in the fundamental role that this can have in the fight against climate change. Renewable energy, actually, reduce pollution, while coal-fired power stations can be reconverted in a circular economy perspective.

Vitruvius and Partners is a leading company in the energy transition sector, thanks to the employment of highly specialized professionals and to the implementation of redevelopment and energy efficiency interventions, such as solar panel and energy storage systems installation or the realization of thermal coats.

Vitruvius & Partners actively contributes to green change and to sustainable development, through several projects in Italy – to enhance and redevelop the territory – but also looks to Europe with the intention of expanding its professional and ethical contribution towards energy transition beyond national boundaries.

excerpt: Vitruvius & Partners, Contractor operating throughout the Italian territory, has recently obtained the ISO 9001 Certification in relation to services related to the…
lede: Vitruvius & Partners, Contractor operating throughout the Italian territory, has recently obtained the ISO 9001 Certification in relation to services related to the maintenance of civil buildings.
html: Through this Certification, Vitruvius & Partners ensures the maintenance and improvement over time of the quality of its goods and services, thereby guaranteeing, increasing professionalism towards its customers and suppliers in terms of reliability and safety. Obtaining such a Certification which is the internationally recognized reference standard for the company quality management, represents, then, an important objective pursued by Vitruvius & Partners with a view to constant growth and continuous improvement.

title: InformazioneOggi.it: First home purchase: it’s not that simple, today we look at high efficiency but prices arise
titleOriginal: InformazioneOggi.it: First home purchase: it’s not that simple, today we look at high efficiency but prices arise
excerpt: First home purchase, despite the general context the trend resists and the builders already look to the house of the future. The propensity…
lede: First home purchase, despite the general context the trend resists and the builders already look to the house of the future.
html:
The propensity of Italians to invest savings for the purchase of the first house has never ceased from the post-war period to today. Instead the need for efficiency and savings on domestic consumption change. The last months have certainly not been the most favorable to engage in a large investment. The house, however, is home to family security not only economic but after the pandemic also that of the health.

titleOriginal: Agenparl.eu: The professions of sustainability – Sustainable construction, 10 photovoltaic experts and electrical engineers wanted to construct buildings that are bill-proof
excerpt: This is the appeal made by Vitruvius & Partners, a general contractor leader in sustainable building, led by Vittorio Ligresti, Roberto Schiavo and…
lede: This is the appeal made by Vitruvius & Partners, a general contractor leader in sustainable building, led by Vittorio Ligresti, Roberto Schiavo and Luca Limone, based in Milan but operating throughout the Italian territory, with a focus on Lombardy.
html:
Sustainable building is the frontier of new generation construction, but also of buildings that need to be renovated. A necessity given both by the new EU directive, which set the 2030 limit for new zero-emission buildings and 2050 for those already existing, and from the need to reduce costs and consumption to have buildings that are “bill proof”.

lede: Between the unemployed and discouraged, in Italy five million people to be included. The III edition of “I sentieri delle professioni” begins. Thousands of opportunities in December
html:
Guidance is becoming increasingly important. Not just for young people looking for a future. Between the unemployes and discouraged, indeed, there are almomst five million people to be included in the job market, which becomes less and less efficient for a problem of mismatch between supply and demand. The paradox is that when unemployment arises the difficulty to find professional figures needed by companies doesn’t decrease. The new Randstad Research survey reveals this.

title: Vitruvius and Partners for ABIO Association

excerpt: It was a pleasure to cooperate with ABIO Association by making a donation to celebrate Easter holidays. ABIO operates in pediatric wards with…
html:
It was a pleasure to cooperate with ABIO Association by making a donation to celebrate Easter holidays.

ABIO operates in pediatric wards with more than 5.000 volunteers, animating the day of children hospitalized and assisting their families during the hard time of hospitalisation. In return for our support, the Association sent us Easter eggs, which the company decided to give to all employees and collaborators.

Thank you ABIO for your amazing work and to all Vitruvius team!
